{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

# Slurm requested:
#   --nodes=1
#   --ntasks-per-node=1
#   --cpus-per-task=23
#   --time=3-23:59:00
#   --job-name=initnet
#   --mail-user=...
#   --mail-type=FAIL,BEGIN,END

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  -c 23 \
  --time=95h59m \
  bash -lc '

# NOTE: Slurm email notifications (--mail-user/--mail-type) have no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but you will not receive start/end/fail notifications.

# NOTE: Slurm --job-name=initnet is not expressed here as a portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

source /N/u/baotruon/Carbonate/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate graph

cd /N/u/baotruon/Carbonate/marketplace
echo "###### init net ######"
snakemake --nolock --snakefile workflow/rules/initnet.smk --cores 23
'
"
}
